verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that search results are limited to the scopes a run is allowed to read. That is an access-control boundary, not a developer-controlled metadata filter, keyword/hybrid search mode, or reranking option. Nothing documents any way to change retrieval beyond the default search, so the story is applicable but unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search
